﻿Is your farm in need of a witch familiar? A spooky little creature? An ossified friend? [b]This might be the mod for you![/b]



[size=5]Instructions[/size]

[list]
[*]Ensure you have [b]Alternative Textures[/b] installed
[*][b]Download [/b]and [b]unpack [/b]the ZIP file
[*][b]Move [/b]the mod into your Mods folder
[*]Once you've started the game, use the [b]scissors tool [/b]provided by Alternative Textures (sold at Robin's shop) to select your favourite little guy!
[/list]
